question: In June 2025, Rajkishore Parhi was chosen for the Bal Sahitya Puraskar for poetry collection, ‘Kete Phula Phutichhi', in which language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Sahitya Akademi** announced the **Bal Sahitya Puraskar** in **June 2025**, recognizing excellence in children's literature across various Indian languages.
 
• **Rajkishore Parhi** was selected for this prestigious honor in the **Odia** language category for his notable contribution to poetry.
 
• The award-winning work is a **poetry collection** titled **‘Kete Phula Phutichhi’** (which translates to "How many flowers have bloomed").
 
• This recognition highlights the importance of **Odia literature** in the national landscape, specifically targeting the creative development and engagement of younger readers.
 
• The selection was made based on books first published during the **five years** immediately preceding
